annotations.title: Dry-run or roll back a TokRepo install session

description: STEP 4 of ATOMIC ACTION 2 (install safely into this repo) — the escape. Roll back a previous TokRepo Codex install session when verify/apply fails or the user rejects the result. Defaults to dry_run=true and last=true. The four-step install atomic action (plan → verify → apply → rollback) is contractually incomplete without this escape.

confirm.description: Required when dry_run=false to prevent accidental deletes.

dry_run.description: When true, return the rollback plan without deleting files. Default true.

force.description: Allow rollback when local files changed since installation.

last.description: Use the latest install/stage session. Default true.

session_id.description: Session id to roll back. Omit when last=true.

name: tokrepo_rollback
